parts.html: The K-30 kitchen model combines white upper cabinets with solid grey lower and remaining fronts, creating a contemporary two-tone kitchen composition. The lighter upper cabinetry helps the furniture feel less visually imposing, while the grey lower cabinets give the design a calm, defined foundation.

The white and grey palette makes K-30 adaptable to a wide range of residential interiors. White upper cabinets can visually brighten the space, while grey fronts coordinate with light walls, ceramic tile, wood textures, and stone-effect surfaces. The combination works well in contemporary apartments, private residences, and open-plan kitchen-living areas.

The defining planning feature of K-30 is its L-shaped configuration. Cabinetry extends along two adjoining walls, making use of the corner and distributing work surfaces and storage between two sections. During individual planning, the sink, hob, refrigerator, and other kitchen functions can be positioned according to the room dimensions and the client’s requirements.

The model has a total linear length of 4.2 meters, with standard dimensions of 4.2 × 2.4 × 0.6 m. Its corner arrangement allows the main work areas and storage to be organized without a separate kitchen island.

K-30 is designed to accommodate built-in household appliances. Their exact positioning can be determined during custom planning, taking into account electrical and plumbing connections as well as the overall room layout. Appliances themselves can be selected separately as part of the individual kitchen specification.

Both upper and lower cabinet fronts are made from laminated particleboard. The upper row features a solid white finish, while the lower and remaining fronts have a solid grey finish. Unlike a wood-look kitchen, the standard K-30 design relies on the contrast between two neutral colors rather than a decorative wood grain.
The cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard, while the countertop is chipboard-based. Cabinet dimensions and internal storage can be adjusted to suit the individual room.

Hinged cabinet doors use Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close. Pull-out elements are fitted with Muller telescopic runners without soft-close. Cabinet handles are included in the standard specification. Lift mechanisms and pull-out cargo storage are not included.

K-30 can be customized beyond its standard materials and hardware. Upon request, the kitchen can be equipped with more functional furniture fittings, upgraded opening mechanisms, and additional storage systems. Alternative materials are also available, ranging from budget-friendly solutions to premium finishes. The final selection of cabinet fronts, countertop materials, and internal fittings depends on the client’s preferences, practical requirements, and project budget.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments and private residences in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-30 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, with adjustments to cabinet runs, worktop arrangements, appliance positions, and storage. Clients can also select their preferred shades of white and grey, alternative cabinet and countertop materials, hardware, and internal fittings.

Our services include kitchen planning, material and hardware selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. Sinks, taps, extractor hoods, and household appliances can also be selected upon request.
